verdict.rationale: The evidence shows substantial programmatic access: official client libraries across popular languages, a REST API reference (the RRF docs link), an inference API offering more control than the default workflow, and an official MCP server. However, nothing states that every UI (Kibana) action is available through the API, and probes found no OpenAPI spec at the main domain. Missing for 10: an explicit statement or documentation of API/UI feature parity, a discoverable OpenAPI spec, and independent corroboration that UI-only workflows are absent.
